result:
The proposed answer of $1/25$ is not supported, so I reject it.

The main gap is the claim that the reduced graph must be triangle-free. The argument finds a $K_5$ only when every pair in the triangle is complete, since it needs common neighbourhoods of two or more vertices to be nonempty and contain edges. With pairwise densities $d<1$, a triangle of clusters need not produce a $K_5$, so the reduction does not apply. Once triangles are allowed with suitable densities, the optimal cut-deficiency can exceed $1/25$. The proposed solution also never justifies its optimisation step, which it asserts without proof.

VERDICT: REJECT
